playstyle.identity: Gragas is a drunken brawler who disrupts with his explosive cask. He can burst squishies or tank depending on build, with strong CC either way.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals on ability use. Q throws a barrel that can be reactivated (more damage if it ferments). W makes next auto deal bonus damage and reduces damage taken. E body slams and stuns. R throws cask that knocks enemies away. E-flash for engage, R to isolate targets.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Gragas spikes at level 6 with his disruptive ultimate. AP for burst, tank for frontline. He's flexible at all stages.

weaknesses: R can knock enemies to safety

passive.name: Happy Hour
passive.details: Every time Gragas uses an ability, he heals for a percentage of his max health.

abilities.name: Barrel Roll
abilities.summary: Roll a barrel that ferments; reactivate to explode, slowing enemies.
abilities.details: Gragas rolls a barrel that ferments over time, dealing increased damage. Reactivate to detonate, damaging and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Drunken Rage
abilities.summary: Channel briefly to reduce damage taken; next auto deals bonus damage.
abilities.details: Gragas drinks, channeling briefly to reduce incoming damage. After drinking, his next auto deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: Body Slam
abilities.summary: Dash and slam, dealing damage and stunning enemies hit.
abilities.details: Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy hit. Enemies hit take damage and are stunned.

abilities.name: Explosive Cask
abilities.summary: Throw a cask that explodes, knocking enemies away from the center.
abilities.details: Gragas throws his cask to a location. On impact, it explodes dealing damage and knocking enemies away from the center.
